incidents.desc: Check up happens before the start, the #101 car runs into the #33 and the #101 car spins on the track, the #12 is involved.
The #25 car moves a little bit up the track and the  #28 car runs into the #25.  The #28 car then gets into the wall.
incidents.ruling: Racing Incident, while the #25 made a slight initial error the #28 failed to make room and protect their own car.

incidents.desc: The #12 just fails to avoid the #787, there was no contention leading up to this
incidents.ruling: #12 is at fault, you need to be aware where other cars are on the track, you cannot run through someone because you're having a good run off the corner.

incidents.desc: Car #12 gets loose exiting pit road and hits the wall.  A caution is brought out.
Car #787 hits the wall and comes back down the track and hits the #92
incidents.ruling: Racing incident, #787 is at fault however this is accidental, practice your high lines.
